aboutus_answer: ITÜK or TalTech Student Council of the School of Information Technologies is...
aboutus_answer2: ...a student organization, whose goal is to represent the interests of the IT-faculty students, and further their education, well-being and offer them entertainment. ITÜK is an abbreviation in Estonian that stands for 'IT-teaduskonna üliõpilaskogu'.
aboutus_answer3: We have members from all the IT-faculty study programmes, who are active, helpful and give a voice to the other students and who can help with studies or everyday problems.
aboutus_card1_description: Leave your mark by organising events and creating unforgettable memories for yourself and fellow students!
aboutus_card2_description: From ITÜK, you can find friends and like-minded students, with whom you can take on future challenges and do great deeds with!
aboutus_status3: Alumni (leaving the organisation or graduating after being a senior member for a year);
aboutus_status4: Board member (a member who represents the organisation).
aboutus_structure2: Every spring the full members elect board members and a chairman who make up the organisation board for a year. Board members are responsible for their respective areas.
aboutus_structure3: All members of ITÜK can run for the board, no matter their member status. But to become a full member one must actively help with organising and creating events or other projects.
aboutus_timeline_more: ...and if more interesting things happen, we'll add them here!

style_title: TalTech IT Faculty Student Council Style Guide
style_name_context: If the name of the ITÜK is used in a context where a considerable part of the readers do not know what ITÜK stands for, please write the name out (e.g., TalTech IT Faculty Student Council).
style_name_valid_text: The name can be spelled as follows:
style_name_valid1: Tallinn University of Technology IT Faculty Student Council
style_name_alt1: Tallinn University of Technology School of IT Faculty Student Council
style_name_alt2: TalTech School of IT Faculty Student Council
style_name_important: Important! Pay attention to the use of uppercase and lowercase letters. It is not allowed to misspell the name of ITÜK!
style_name_abbreviation: The abbreviation ITÜK is not hyphenated.
style_logo_description: Here you can download all versions of the logo. Please avoid using raster graphics. For web use SVG files and for print use PDF files. Please avoid using SVG for print and PDF for web, as they are in RGB and CMYK color models respectively, which are not directly convertible.
style_logo_internal_heading: Use of the logo with or without the TalTech logo
style_logo_internal_context: Within TalTech, the ITÜK logo is used without the TalTech logo to avoid repetition of the same logo in events, posters, advertisements, etc. Outside TalTech, a logo version is used with the TalTech logo.
style_logo_variants_use2: When the long logo is not readable.
style_logo_variants_use3: In case it is easy to associate ITÜK with the icon.
style_logo_icon_usage: The icon can be used with or without a box.
style_colors_instructions: When choosing the colours for the logo, please note:
style_colors_usage1: Colored logo - use on a white or very light background (the darkest background allowed is #ebebeb).
style_colors_usage2: Black logo - use on a white or light background (the darkest background allowed is #a1a1a1).
style_colors_usage3: White logo - use on a coloured or dark background
style_colors_contrast: The text on the logo MUST comply with the WCAG AAA standard. Check it
style_protected_description: The logo must have a protected area on all sides, the width of which is equal to the '_' width of the '>' character in the logo. For example:
style_protected_instructions: No other elements may be placed in the protected area.
style_typography_description: ITÜK uses Raleway font for logos. The font used in the body text is Noto Sans Georgian.
style_contact_description: Any questions about the brand identity of the ITÜK can be sent to the following email address:
style_contact_note: Please do not be creative with the identity, but coordinate all questions with ITÜK.

infoohtud_intro1: Info evenings are the easiest way to get to know ITÜK. We give an overview of what the School of IT Student Council does over the academic year, introduce TalTech student life more broadly – including the Rector's Cup – and talk about how you can get involved in organising things yourself.
infoohtud_intro2: First-year students are especially welcome, but the door is open to all students of the faculty, whatever year you're in! The most valuable thing you can get from an info evening is the connections you make: fellow students starting at the same time as you, and members from older years who you can ask for advice about your studies and ITÜK. Getting involved in project teams gives you real organising experience from your very first semester, and memories that stick around.
infoohtud_intro3: There are four info evenings this year - join whichever suits you best. We'll be providing food, drinks, and of course, great company. Details for each one are in its corresponding Facebook event. PS! The informative part is in estonian only.
infoevenings_aboutus: Get to know us at one of our info evenings
